{{Quote|Have&hellip; Have you come to ''hurt'' us?''"<br />"''Of course not! What are you children ''doing'' here?|[[Kralla]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Downhill">{{TCWComicCite|6.43|Downhill}}</ref>}}
'''Felucians''' were a short [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to a [[Unidentified Felucian homeworld|nameless]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], who would later become a non-native population on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], which they migrated and settled as farmers and traders on their adopted world.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Felucian_farmers.png|thumb|left|250x250px|A group of Felucian farmers and youths]]
Felucians were short in stature, with thick legs and four-fingered hands.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}}</ref> They were a small [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] species that shared some characteristics with [[Tortoise/Legends|tortoises]], such as an elongated neck and thick limbs,<ref name=":1">{{SW|url=news/felucia-cellophane-flowers-of-yellow-and-green-and-rancors|text=Felucia: Cellophane Flowers Of Yellow And Green&hellip;And Rancors|nolive=1}}</ref> with beady eyes that were often hidden behind [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]]. Their skin varied in tone from orange to light green.<ref name=":0" /> They were related to the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
At some point the species later known as Felucians migrated on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]<ref name="TEA" /> from another [[Unidentified Felucian homeworld|unnamed world]]<ref name=":1" /> and settled as farmers and traders.<ref name="TEA" />

A group of Felucians, led by [[Casiss/Legends|Casiss]], tended to a [[Akira/Legends|nysillin farm]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Threatened by [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Hondo's gang of pirates]] who wanted to steal their crops,<ref name=":0" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref>{{FactFile2013|88|22 BBY 97-98: Bane of the Jedi Order}} dates the events of "[[Bounty Hunters (episode)|Bounty Hunters]]" to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> they hired [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi's]] band of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to protect them. However, they received combat training from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who helped them defend their farm, and taught them to fend for themselves from then on. Later some Felucians served the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] during the [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|Second Battle of Felucia]].<ref name=":0" />

Felucians continued to be still targeted by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to at least around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref>The events set during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[Kinect Star Wars|''Kinect Star Wars'']] take place around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] based on the fact that in "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]" [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had not been attacked before then. As there is an [[Trihexalon attack on Coruscant|attack]] on Coruscant in the game, it must therefore take place after that event.</ref><ref>"[[Downhill]]" is set after "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]" ([[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]), as "''[[Mandalorian Memories]]''" serves as a prequel to the episode. Considering that the [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] featured in [[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars Comic UK'']] are published in chronological order, it can be concluded that "''[[Downhill]]''" takes place in 20 BBY.</ref> One Felucian named [[Drez Unlin]] had business with the Confederacy.<ref name="The Masked Racer">{{SWComicCite|7.3|The Masked Racer}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Originally, the Felucian farmers shared their name<ref name="SWArchive-The Clone Wars Episode Guide: Bounty Hunters">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode217.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Bounty Hunters}}</ref> with the [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Force-sensitive Felucians]] introduced in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'',<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> but this was rectified with the publication of [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 67|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 67]], which identified the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Felucians as "Jungle Felucians."<ref name="Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 67">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 67|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 67]]</ref>
